## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A three-*juan* late-Míng systematic exposition by **Bèilín Réncháo** 貝琳仁潮 of the Buddhist *fǎjiè* 法界 (*dharmadhātu*) cosmological structure, with topographical-cosmological diagrams. The work belongs to the late-Míng Buddhist cosmographic tradition that systematised the foundational Buddhist cosmological materials (*Sumeru* cosmology, the *trichiliocosm*, the *six paths*, etc.) into accessible visual-textual form for late-imperial readership.

**Abstract**

The composition is bracketed within the late-Míng productive period (1573–1644).
